Local source observation: ClusterOutcome.obligations counts obligation_edges keys and targets. compute_closure only inserts own provided obligations into that graph while processing required guarantees. A standalone provided contract can therefore be checked by check_provided_guarantees yet omitted from the displayed count.
Acceptance: count actual scoped obligations independently of dependency edges, expose provided/required/evaluated counts with clear semantics, and verify isolated provided contracts, dependency chains, bridge-only packages, and genuinely empty scope. Do not infer zero evaluated obligations solely from the old display. Reassess the pilot zero-count claim using manifests and actual consumed records.

subissues.title: Support assurance intake for standalone reviewed obligations
subissues.description:
Parent: Ligature port-feedback epic #143.
Blocks: release verification and downstream handoff #161.
Downstream project issue: full-ligature-port-workspace/date-creusot Chainlink #138.

Reproduced with Ligature 1.3.12 (source 34fb1a1372bd69e38a92f1468db6c4245a609518; bundle SHA-256 87ca4814b39def8f7f236f6c6a9be554992425112c339e22f0521e56c2e35028) in the date-creusot project at committed revision 729f0432c90dd7916bdbeecb750b9d5abbbbf5cd. Evidence: findings/limitations.jsonl entry date-creusot-063 and analysis/verification/creusot-0.14-2026-10-16.md.

Minimal repro (from the project root, with the active issue-scoped manifest grant):
`python3 tools/ligature/ligature.pyz generate-work-package --plan analysis/verification/stage-7-plan-WP-DATE-CREUSOT-issue-138.json --issue 138 --toolchain rustc-1.90.0/cargo-creusot-0.14.0-dev/why3-1.8.2 --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --grant-id <active-138-manifest-grant> --json`
Observed: exit 2, `missing-source: no interaction reliance declares required_assurance for obligation 'YearMonthDay.C007'; the derivation will not invent one`. No manifest was written and the grant was not consumed.

C007 is the reviewed, separate postcondition for YearMonthDay.round_trip, mapped by the approved concept spec and backed by a fresh Creusot certificate. It is a standalone method obligation with no caller/callee interaction. Reusing C002 would conflate round_trip with from_days; inventing an interaction would misstate the call graph.

Acceptance: add a sanctioned, reviewable source for assurance requirements of standalone provided obligations (for example, the reviewed constraint plus owning verifier policy, or an explicit plan field). Preserve claim/evidence kind, minimum scope, trust policy, method/proof mapping, and freshness checks. Do not manufacture an interaction or infer assurance from an unrelated reliance. Verify the approved nine-obligation project plan generates C007 and G14 reports consuming its fresh round_trip certificate.

subissues.title: Add grant-bound regeneration for existing generated work-package manifests
subissues.description:
Parent: Ligature port-feedback epic #143.
Blocks: release verification and downstream handoff #161.
Downstream project issue: full-ligature-port-workspace/date-creusot Chainlink #140.

Reproduced with Ligature 1.3.12 (source 34fb1a1372bd69e38a92f1468db6c4245a609518; bundle SHA-256 87ca4814b39def8f7f236f6c6a9be554992425112c339e22f0521e56c2e35028) in the date-creusot project at committed revision 729f0432c90dd7916bdbeecb750b9d5abbbbf5cd. Evidence: findings/limitations.jsonl entry date-ligature-103 and analysis/verification/creusot-0.14-2026-10-16.md.

Minimal repro: in a disposable copy containing the existing generated ci/manifest/WP-DATE-CREUSOT.json, issue an exact write grant for that path and run Stage 7 with a valid plan whose derived output differs (the captured probe used an eight-obligation plan to isolate replacement behavior; the live approved nine-obligation plan separately stops at date-creusot-063):
`python3 tools/ligature/ligature.pyz generate-work-package --plan <valid-plan-with-changed-derived-bytes> --issue 140 --toolchain rustc-1.90.0/cargo-creusot-0.14.0-dev/why3-1.8.2 --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --grant-id <active-140-manifest-grant> --json`
Observed: exit 2, `target-conflict: ci/manifest/WP-DATE-CREUSOT.json already exists with different bytes; it was left untouched`. The live generated manifest remains unchanged and still directs assurance output to ci/results/feature_ledger.json, colliding with the feature-ledger projection.

Acceptance: provide a sanctioned, exact-path and issue-grant-bound update/regeneration flow for an existing generated manifest. Validate the full candidate (including current approved obligation scope, provenance and report.emit), then atomically replace the generated artifact and record auditable update provenance; on any refusal, preserve the old bytes. The canonical assurance output is ci/results/<work-package>.json, with the feature ledger separate. Verify either output can be regenerated while preserving the other. Do not permit silent scope widening/narrowing, hand edits, deletion, or a second package identity to bypass the guard.
